rubric.role_summary: Staff-level product management role on a payments platform, leading projects across card-scheme coverage, payment processing and infrastructure, from ideation through launch.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Staff-level product management role on a payments platform, leading projects across card-scheme coverage, payment processing and infrastructure, from ideation through launch.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 8+ years of professional experience.
- Bachelor's degree or above.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Exposure to a high-growth environment.
- Engineering or computer science coursework.
- Deep payment-processing expertise, including direct integrations with Visa and MasterCard; acquiring-side experience is preferred.
- Technical understanding sufficient to engage in architectural discussions with engineering teams.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): San Francisco Bay Area, California. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Hybrid work is based in one of these areas.

location.requirement_text: Location: San Francisco Bay Area, California. Hybrid work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.

soft_requirements: Competitive GPA; no objective threshold is stated.
Excellent communication and ability to convey product strategy to technical and non-technical audiences.
Close attention to detail, ability to structure complex problems, and data- and first-principles-informed judgment.
Drive, grit, persistence, ownership, and ability to move ideas to reality quickly.
Ability to thrive in cross-cultural and cross-functional teams.
